newsitem.title: USA: SITEL to change fiscal year, auditing firm.
newsitem.headline: SITEL to change fiscal year, auditing firm.

text.p: SITEL Corp said Wednesday that in conjunction with its September 1996 acquisition of Mitre Plc, it will change its fiscal yearend to December 31 from May 31. It also has selected KPMG as SITEL's sole independent auditor.
KPMG had been the independent auditor for Mitre Plc, which had a December 31 fiscal year. Coopers & Lybrand L.L.P. previously served as SITEL's auditor.

KPMG, a professional services firm, operates through more than 1,100 offices in 837 cities in 134 countries. SITEL provides outsourced telephone-based customer service and sales programs on behalf of large corporations worldwide.
